_: It.26: a HIREABLE follower that plugs into the VANILLA follower system — no custom dialogue or scripts. PRIMARY PATH = the PAID hireling: she's in PotentialHireling (Skyrim.esm:0x0BCC9A), so vanilla's DialogueFollower drives the 'I need your help. I'll pay you.' topic → gold transaction → she joins; all the follow/wait/dismiss commands work, no Papyrus from us. This path is the one that works from purely STATIC records, because that hire topic is gated on faction MEMBERSHIP, not on a player relationship (a static RELA to the player reads rank 0 at runtime — useless; see gotchas.md #6). The FREE 'Follow me' topic also requires PotentialFollowerFaction (Skyrim.esm:0x05C84D) + GetRelationshipRank player >= Ally; both are kept here for completeness, but the relationship won't surface that topic without `setrelationshiprank player 3` (or a script), so in-game she's reliably recruitable via the PAID line. She needs a follower-capable voice (FemaleEvenToned 0x013ADD, in VoicesFollowerNeutral) and the citizenship factions so she traverses doors/gates when you lead her out. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, wait ~30-90s, talk to her, pick the hire line — she joins and trails you (incl. across fast travel, per It.21).

relationships._: Ally relationship to the player. parent = the follower; child = the Player NPC base (Skyrim.esm:0x000014 — NOT PlayerRef 0x000007, which is the placed ACHR; a RELA pointing at an ACHR is a type mismatch that CRASHES on load). Intended for the free-follow gate (GetRelationshipRank >= Ally) — but a STATIC RELA to the player reads rank 0 at runtime (gotchas.md #6), so this does NOT actually surface the free topic in-game; the PotentialHireling paid path is what works without a script. Kept for documentation/completeness.

npcs.name: Sera the Forged
npcs._greeting: Required so she is CONVERSABLE — a custom NPC with no custom dialogue isn't talkable just from being follower-eligible; the build gives her a host quest + Hello, and the vanilla 'Follow me' topic then surfaces on top.
npcs.greeting: Need a sword arm? I'm listening.
npcs._voiceType: FemaleEvenToned (0x013ADD) — MUST be a voice in VoicesFollowerNeutral (0x0D23AC) or the vanilla 'Follow me' hire topic's GetIsVoiceType condition fails and it never shows. FemaleNord/MaleNord are CITIZEN voices, NOT follower voices. Female follower voices: FemaleEvenToned 013ADD, FemaleSultry 013AE0, FemaleCondescending 013AE4, FemaleYoungEager 013ADC. Male: MaleEvenToned 013AD2, MaleYoungEager 013AD1, MaleEvenTonedAccented 0EA267.
npcs._factions: Whiterun crime/citizen factions (0x0267EA + 0x028172) for door/gate traversal; PotentialFollowerFaction (0x05C84D) — keyed by the free 'Follow me' dialogue; PLUS PotentialHireling (0x0BCC9A) — keyed by vanilla's PAID hireling dialogue, the path that actually recruits her from static records (no script, no console). All resolve as plain external <master>:0xFORMID refs and are added at faction rank 0, exactly like vanilla mercenaries (Jenassa/Belrand etc. sit in PotentialHireling).

placements._: Sera in the Sleeping Giant Inn common room near the patrons (a no-package NPC at the cell origin 0,0,0 lands off-navmesh and is unreachable; actors snap to navmesh so any in-room coord works).
